verdict.rationale: A probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at omarchy.org/llms.txt), so the core artifact is absent. Omarchy does ship agent skills to help an agent build apps, plugins and themes, and its manual points to the documented `omarchy` CLI as a way for an AI agent to handle customization and configuration. That is real agent-oriented guidance, but it is indirect. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt, dedicated agent-readable docs (e.g. markdown/LLM-formatted manual), and independent confirmation that agents can consume the docs/skills effectively.
